evidence.detail: The constructor writes the exact surviving overlay identity literal 'RaidPartyOverlay' into the shared positioned-overlay base.
The overlay renders only the exact labels 'Your points:' and 'Time:' plus their live values inside one fixed 127x34 raid-party status surface.
The class stores a timer start timestamp and, unless frozen by packet state, recomputes the displayed elapsed time once per second using the exact '%d:%02d' format.
R123 ScriptPacket 41 directly constructs and mutates this class: selector 18 initializes/toggles the raid party overlay timer, selector 19 updates points and selector 20 updates the displayed time.

proposals.note: RaidPartyOverlay is fixed by the exact surviving identity literal and a complete points/timer raid-party status lifecycle. R123 independently fixes its ScriptPacket 41 owner. Confidence is 0.999.

evidence.detail: The constructor writes the exact surviving overlay identity literal 'RaidTheatreBar' into the shared overlay base.
The class owns one fixed 504x20 overlay surface and records only its current Graphics2D clip x/y anchor for the sibling raid theatre progress renderer.
The sibling rs/l/f/a/g/b renderer consumes RaidTheatreBar.r/s as its placement anchor and draws one 500-pixel proportional raid progress bar with packet-fed text/state.
R123 ScriptPacket 41 constructs/manages the raid-theatre overlay family together with RaidPartyOverlay; no non-raid caller or second domain is present.

proposals.note: RaidTheatreBar is fixed by the exact surviving identity literal and its single fixed raid-theatre bar anchor contract, consumed only by the sibling raid progress renderer under R123 ScriptPacket 41 ownership. Confidence is 0.999.
